newsitem.title: FINLAND: CREATING EMU AMONG KEY NEAR TERM EU TASKS - LIPPONEN.
newsitem.headline: CREATING EMU AMONG KEY NEAR TERM EU TASKS - LIPPONEN.

text.p: Implementing EMU is one of the European Union's most important tasks in the near future and Finland will contribute to make the single currency come true, Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen said on Wednesday.

"The economic importance and political responsibility of Germany is emphasised now that the EU is seeking means to enhance its ability to act, and is putting the final touches on implementing the third stage of economic and monetary union and is preparing to receive new members," Lipponen said in the text of a prepared speech.
He spoke in Bonn on the first day of two-day visit to Germany. A copy of his prepared speech was released in Helsinki.
"Finland will contribute to implement these union goals," Lipponen said.
"Implementing EMU and expanding the EU are in our view the union's most important tasks in the near future," he said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
